notes: PAP reference H21/01879. Whole vacant two-room apartment in central Orleans, in a secured residence built in 1992. The complete advert describes an entrance with storage, living room and bedroom opening onto a south-facing 20 m2 terrace overlooking the residence garden, a separate fitted kitchen, bathroom, separate WC, cellar and basement parking space. Residents also have access to a coproperty tennis court. The advert explicitly states that the apartment is free of all occupation. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 21 September 2026.

PAP reference H21/01893. Whole three-room apartment in central Orleans, approximately 200 metres from the railway station, tram and bus centre, in a secured four-floor residence. The complete advert describes a ground-floor apartment facing an inner square and coproperty garden, with entrance and storage, 20 m2 living room, separate fitted kitchen, two bedrooms, bathroom, separate WC, cellar and basement parking space. The advert presents it as suitable to occupy or invest in and contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 8 property photos and a publication date of 10 September 2026.
